modules.responsibility: HTTP process entrypoint, listener configuration, and graceful shutdown
bounded HTTP workflow checks for local verification
routing, JSON boundaries, and status mapping
cross-aggregate workflow orchestration and atomic commit boundaries
mutex-protected in-memory persistence with atomic commits
public requests and stable error contracts

workflows.name: Register specimen
steps: decode and validate the public request
apply specimen identity and status invariants
commit the new specimen without replacing an existing catalog number
workflows.success: returns the registered specimen and a readable snapshot
workflows.failure: returns stable validation or duplicate catalog number errors
workflows.verification: workflowcheck registers a specimen and reads it through GET /specimens/{id}

workflows.name: Approve preparation plan
steps: create one draft plan for an eligible specimen
validate the approver and current draft state
commit plan approval and specimen preparation in one repository mutation
workflows.success: returns an approved plan and a specimen in preparing status
workflows.failure: returns conflict for an invalid specimen state or a second open plan
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a plan, approves it, and verifies both plan and specimen states

workflows.name: Log preparation progress
steps: load the approved plan and its ordered progress records
enforce monotonic percentages and completion rules
commit the entry and any terminal state changes together
workflows.success: returns the progress entry and marks the plan completed at one hundred percent
workflows.failure: returns conflict for a non-monotonic percentage or work on a closed plan
workflows.verification: workflowcheck records partial and final progress, then verifies completed plan and stabilized specimen states

workflows.name: Release for study
steps: verify the specimen is stabilized
verify that no unfinished plan remains
create the permanent release record and mark the specimen available
workflows.success: returns the release record and makes the specimen available
workflows.failure: returns conflict if the specimen is unstable or still has an unfinished plan
workflows.verification: workflowcheck completes preparation, releases the specimen, and verifies the terminal state

workflows.name: Prepare a multi-specimen batch with shared stage facts
steps: create specimens, draft plans, members and batch in one atomic mutation
approve every draft member plan together
record shared stage facts with independent per-member percentages
keep the batch open while individual members complete independently
close the batch only after every member plan is completed
workflows.success: returns batch snapshots where each member keeps its own plan, percentage and stabilized state
workflows.failure: returns conflict for a finished batch, a non-member plan, duplicate stage entries or early close
workflows.verification: workflowcheck creates a three-member batch, shares stage facts, finishes members independently and closes once

workflows.name: Resolve concurrent batch and plan progress deterministically
steps: serialize all writes through the repository mutex transaction
allocate contiguous shared stage fact sequences
apply monotonic percentage rules under same-plan races
finish members concurrently without touching batch lifecycle
workflows.success: produces ordered stage facts, a monotonic progress trail and one successful close
workflows.failure: losing racers receive conflict responses and regressions are never committed
workflows.verification: workflowcheck fires parallel stage writers and parallel same-plan progress writes and asserts convergence

workflows.name: Cancel and split multi-specimen batches
steps: reject batch creation as a whole on duplicate member catalogs
cancel a batch together with all draft member plans
reject cancellation once any member is approved
move only draft members into a new batch while the source keeps one member
workflows.success: cancels batch and drafts atomically, or produces a new open batch with the moved drafts
workflows.failure: returns conflict for active members, emptying the source batch or moving non-member plans
workflows.verification: workflowcheck verifies rollback on failed creation, draft cancellation, split boundaries and independent cancel after split

complexity.notes: Plan and specimen state changes share one repository mutation; duplicate catalog numbers and unfinished plans are rejected at commit time. Multi-specimen batches extend the same all-or-nothing mutation to batch, members, specimens, plans and shared stage facts; member completion is independent, close stays explicit, and cancellation and split are guarded lifecycle transitions resolved deterministically under the repository mutex.
